import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')

export function makeShirt() {
  seed = 4242
  const w = 1024
  const h = 512
  const canvas = makeCanvas(w, h)
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')

  // Off-white knitted cotton, kept bright so the print survives the gloom.
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#f6f1e4')
  bg.addColorStop(0.55, '#e9e3d4')
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#d5cfc0')
  ctx.fillStyle = bg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)

  for (let i = 0; i < 9000; i++) {
    const v = random() > 0.5 ? 255 : 150
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${v},${v},${v - 10},${0.02 + random() * 0.05})`
    ctx.fillRect(random() * w, random() * h, 1 + random() * 3, 1 + random() * 5)
  }
  // Fabric folds.
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const x = random() * w
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + 90, 0)
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,112,96,0)')
    g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(120,112,96,0.09)')
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,112,96,0)')
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.fillRect(x, 0, 90, h)
  }

  const text = 'I LOVE 2016'
  const size = fitText(ctx, text, 700, 152, '900')
  ctx.font = `900 ${size}px "Arial Black", "DejaVu Sans", Impact, sans-serif`
  ctx.textAlign = 'left'
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'
  const heartSize = size * 0.92
  const gap = size * 0.16
  const textWidth = ctx.measureText(text).width
  const totalWidth = textWidth + gap + heartSize
  const startX = (w - totalWidth) / 2
  const midY = h * 0.52

  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(0, 3)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(78, 68, 53, 0.16)'
  ctx.fillText(text, startX + 1, midY + 1)
  ctx.restore()

  ctx.fillStyle = '#171716'
  ctx.fillText(text, startX, midY)

  const hx = startX + textWidth + gap + heartSize / 2
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(hx, midY + heartSize * 0.16)
  heartPath(ctx, 0, 0, heartSize)
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -heartSize * 0.6, 0, heartSize * 0.35)
  hg.addColorStop(0, '#ef5b54')
  hg.addColorStop(1, '#a81218')
  ctx.fillStyle = hg
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.lineWidth = 6
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#171716'
  ctx.stroke()
  ctx.restore()

  // A little worn texture over the print.
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop'
  for (let i = 0; i < 2600; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.015 + random() * 0.04})`
    ctx.fillRect(random() * w, random() * h, 1 + random() * 2, 1 + random() * 2)
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'

  return textureFromCanvas(canvas)
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build an interactive Three.js web experience from the user's prompt: a ridiculously muscular anthropomorphic apricot (“KAYISI”) fighting two absurd opponents with multiple weapons, touch controls, optional accelerometer tilt, and iOS motion permission.

## Requirements
- Main character must unmistakably be a muscular anthropomorphic apricot (kayısı), not a peach, orange, generic fruit, or human in a costume; realistic apricot skin texture, warm orange color, enormus muscles, six-pack, muscular legs.
- Skinny, extremely smelly, frail mute man with a large sign showing exact Turkish text: `Aciz bir dilsizim`.
- Obese heavily bearded man wearing a T-shirt with exact readable text: `I LOVE 2016 ♥️`.
- Apricot fights both simultaneously, switching among baseball bats, swords, metal pipes, hammers, and improvised weapons with exaggerated combat moves.
- Absurd, chaotic, dark-comedy action tone; detailed characters, expressive faces, dynamic poses, cinematic camera, dramatic lighting, detailed environment.
- Phone/tablet touch controls; optional accelerometer tilt; request motion permission on iOS.
- Preserve exact sign and T-shirt text.

## Decisions
- Built a playable 3D Three.js/Vite game, not a static image, because of the touch-control and tilt requirements.
- Procedural characters/environment/weapons via Three.js primitives and canvas textures; no external model assets.
- Layout: hero left, skinny mute center-right, obese 2016 man right; camera 3/4 front to keep faces, sign, and shirt readable.
- Characters' torsos angle toward camera while heads aim at opponents; skinny's sign is billboarded toward camera for legibility.
- Combat: auto-target nearest enemy, six weapon types auto-switch after each attack, damage/knockback/KO/respawn, combo counter, enemy AI attacks, hero health/regen, sound synthesis, screen shake, particles, comic popups.
- Mobile: virtual joystick, SMASH and SWAP buttons, tilt toggle; iOS `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` on toggle.
- Sign uses exact `Aciz bir dilsizim`; shirt uses `I LOVE 2016` plus a vector heart for guaranteed rendering; HUD repeats both exact strings.
- Shirt print texture made transparent so it no longer appears as a white rectangular panel.

## Work State
### Completed
- Scaffolded Vite project with `three`; build succeeds.
- Implemented arena, lighting, neon `KAYISI` sign, crowd, fence, props, dust, cinematic camera, HUD, intro overlay, KO/rematch overlay.
- Implemented muscular apricot with custom cleft/taper head, two leaves, stem, angry face, teeth, six-pack, pecs, belt, veins, and apricot skin texture.
- Implemented skinny mute with large exact-text sign, stink wisps, flies, nervous animation.
- Implemented obese bearded man with curved exact-text shirt print, beard, sweat; improved camera-facing angle and full text visibility.
- Implemented weapons: nail bat, katana, metal pipe, sledgehammer, folding chair, frying pan.
- Implemented attacks, auto weapon switching, enemy damage/KO/respawn, enemy attacks, hero damage/KO, combo UI, sound, FX.
- Verified desktop gameplay screenshots; scene loads without console errors (only warnings); intro and gameplay look good.
- Verified fat man's shirt now shows `I LOVE 2016 ♥` readably after facing-camera blend fix.
- Server running via tmux session `kayisi` on port `3002`; Vite watch rebuilds `dist`.

### Active
- Tuning attack poses/weapon visibility: latest burst screenshots show katana visible and auto-switch to `KATANA` works, but need verify all six weapons, hit poses, and both-enemy hits.
- Need test mobile portrait/landscape layout and tilt toggle behavior.
- Need inspect screenshots for hero side seam/leaf changes and overall polish.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/shots/swing0.png` … `swing6.png` to evaluate attack animation and weapon visibility.
2. Test all six attacks via repeated `#attackBtn` clicks; verify auto-switch UI, damage, enemy reactions, both-target chair sweep.
3. Take mobile screenshots using `playwright-cli resize 390 844` and evaluate HUD/control overlap, readability of sign/shirt.
4. Verify tilt toggle gives expected toast/permission behavior; test keyboard fallback (WASD, Space, Q, R, M, T).
5. Run the official capture script or equivalent (`CAPTURE_URL`, `CAPTURE_DIR`) to confirm desktop/mobile final screenshots and no page errors.
6. Fix any issues found, rebuild, and leave final project ready.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, input, attacks, AI, camera, HUD, state.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/models.js`: apricot, skinny man, fat man, weapons, health bars.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arena.js`: environment, lighting, neon, crowd, props.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: apricot skin, sign text, shirt print, concrete/wood/neon textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/fx.js`: particles, shockwaves, slash arcs, popups.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio sound.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: HUD/intro/KO DOM and exact-text references.
